sources.institution: Chengde Mountain Resort Scenic Area Service Center

facts.purpose: The Hall of Simplicity and Piety was the principal palace pavilion for court and major ceremonies.
facts.timber: The Qing imperial accounts document nanmu acquisition and shipment for this hall.

facts.finish: Warmed waxed nanmu structure without polychrome paint.

sources.institution: Chengde local report archived by Sina

facts.construction: Single-eave rounded hip-and-gable roof, gray roof tiles, bluish brick walls, unpainted nanmu beams, columns and screens.

facts.sequence: The numbered historic palace sequence places Nanmu Dian after the inner gate and before Sizhi Shuwu and Yanbo Zhishuang.
